The following events took place in '''272 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*A [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|queen]] ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Beaded emblems from [[Gender/Legends|her]] dress would later be worn on the [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends|foreign residence gown]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padme Amidala]] of Naboo<ref name="EP1">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="EP1date">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states that a [[Unidentified Queen of Naboo (c. 272 BBY)|queen]] ruled [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] over 240 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], which took place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> {{Circa}}
